Definition: Azzur, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Azzur is the name of three men — a prince of the people who stood before Ezekiel in the vision of the temple, the father of the false prophet Hananiah who broke Jeremiah's yoke, and one who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah's day. One name, three very different men: a prince, a prophet's father, and a signer.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the contrast is the lesson: one Azzur's son lied in God's name, and another Azzur signed the covenant to keep it. The name is the same; the choice is what matters.
